global_rules: Never add quantities with different dimensions.
Every numeric parameter must declare coordinate space, unit, range and whether it is normalized.
Dimensionless shader values may still require explicit color-space or encoding declarations.
For constraints C with dimensions other than length, XPBD compliance and lambda dimensions must be recalculated.
A conditional dimensional pass does not certify the formula against its primary publication.
